blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Palace press officer Claire Castro on Tuesday called “absolutely delusional” the call for President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to step down from office. This came after Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesperson, Paolo Panelo Jr., said Monday that Marcos is “trivializing” Duterte’s “serious accusations” against him, claiming this proved that he is out of touch with reality and not fit for office. READ: Duterte camp: Marcos ‘out of touch with reality, not fit for office’ Duterte’s spokesperson was referring to Marcos’ earlier comments on Duterte’s derogatory remarks, in which she called him corrupt and a drug addict, among others.
